DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри дощ, вони грали у футбол.
en: Despite the rain, they played football.
In spite of the rain, they played football.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри втому, вона завершила роботу.
en: Despite being tired, she has finished the work.
In spite of being tired, she has finished the work.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Він прийшов на зустріч, попри те, що почувався зле.
en: Despite feeling ill, he came to the meeting.
In spite of feeling ill, he came to the meeting.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на дощ, ми все одно йдемо гуляти.
en: Despite it raining, we are still going for a walk.
In spite of it raining, we are still going for a walk.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на затримку, зустріч пройшла успішно.
en: Despite being delayed, the meeting was successful.
In spite of being delayed, the meeting was successful.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що він працював цілий день, він ще не завершив проєкт.
en: Despite working all day, he hasn’t finished the project yet.
In spite of working all day, he hasn’t finished the project yet.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що він запізнився, його впустили на лекцію.
en: Despite being late, he was allowed into the lecture.
In spite of being late, he was allowed into the lecture.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на відсутність доказів, це може бути правдою.
en: Despite the lack of evidence, it might be true.
In spite of the lack of evidence, it might be true.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на попередження, вони пішли в море під час шторму.
en: Despite the warning, they went to sea during the storm.
In spite of the warning, they went to sea during the storm.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Ми підемо на прогулянку, незважаючи на те, що буде холодно.
en: We’ll go for a walk despite it being cold.
We’ll go for a walk in spite of it being cold.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що зараз іде дощ, діти граються надворі.
en: Despite it raining now, the children are playing outside.
In spite of it raining now, the children are playing outside.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що він уже закінчив роботу, він залишився допомогти.
en: Despite having finished his work, he stayed to help.
In spite of having finished his work, he stayed to help.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на свої страхи, вона виступила на сцені.
en: Despite her fears, she performed on stage.
In spite of her fears, she performed on stage.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що фільм був знятий давно, він усе ще популярний.
en: Despite being made years ago, the film is still popular.
In spite of being made years ago, the film is still popular.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на труднощі, команда виграє змагання.
en: Despite the difficulties, the team will win the competition.
In spite of the difficulties, the team will win the competition.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри дощ і бруд, діти насолоджувалися грою.
en: Despite the rain and mud, the children enjoyed the game.
In spite of the rain and mud, the children enjoyed the game.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри те, що вона вивчала англійську роками, їй важко вільно говорити.
en: Despite studying English for years, she finds it hard to speak fluently.
In spite of studying English for years, she finds it hard to speak fluently.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на сильний дощ, вони дісталися додому без проблем.
en: Despite the heavy rain, they got home safely.
In spite of the heavy rain, they got home safely.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Вона сказала, що, попри втому, вона продовжувала працювати.
en: She said that despite being tired, she kept working.
She said that in spite of being tired, she kept working.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на втрату підтримки, він зберіг спокій.
en: Despite losing support, he remained calm.
In spite of losing support, he remained calm.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри ризики, це може бути вигідною інвестицією.
en: Despite the risks, it might be a profitable investment.
In spite of the risks, it might be a profitable investment.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що його було звільнено, він залишився дуже спокійним.
en: Despite being fired, he stayed very calm.
In spite of being fired, he stayed very calm.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри те, що він отримав пораду, він зробив усе по-своєму.
en: Despite having received advice, he did everything his own way.
In spite of having received advice, he did everything his own way.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що було темно, вони продовжували йти вперед.
en: Despite it being dark, they kept moving forward.
In spite of it being dark, they kept moving forward.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри погану погоду, зібралося багато глядачів.
en: Despite the bad weather, there were many spectators.
In spite of the bad weather, there were many spectators.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри втому, він часто залишається на роботі допізна.
en: Despite being tired, he often stays late at work.
In spite of being tired, he often stays late at work.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що вони вже прибули, зустріч ще не почалася.
en: Despite having arrived, the meeting hadn’t started yet.
In spite of having arrived, the meeting hadn’t started yet.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри всі ризики, компанія досягне успіху.
en: Despite the risks, the company will succeed.
In spite of the risks, the company will succeed.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри обмежений час, у нас є шанс завершити проєкт вчасно.
en: Despite the limited time, we have a chance to complete the project on time.
In spite of the limited time, we have a chance to complete the project on time.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри негоду, люди прийшли на ярмарок.
en: Despite the bad weather, people came to the fair.
In spite of the bad weather, people came to the fair.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що він закінчив навчання, він залишився в університеті як викладач.
en: Despite having graduated, he stayed at the university as a teacher.
In spite of having graduated, he stayed at the university as a teacher.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що були прийняті заходи, проблема все одно не зникла.
en: Despite measures being taken, the problem still has not disappeared.
Despite the fact that measures were taken, the problem still didn’t disappear.
In spite of measures being taken, the problem still has not disappeared.
In spite of the fact that measures were taken, the problem still didn’t disappear.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що було складно, учасники досягли мети.
en: Despite it being difficult, the participants achieved their goal.
In spite of it being difficult, the participants achieved their goal.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на ризики, проєкт може виявитися успішним.
en: Despite the risks, the project might turn out to be successful.
In spite of the risks, the project might turn out to be successful.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри значний прогрес, залишається ще багато роботи.
en: Despite having made significant progress, there is still much work to do.
In spite of having made significant progress, there is still much work to do.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на заходи, які були впроваджені урядом, проблема залишається невирішеною.
en: Despite the measures implemented by the government, the problem remains unsolved.
In spite of the measures implemented by the government, the problem remains unsolved.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що економіка зростає вже кілька років, нерівність не зменшується.
en: Despite the economy having been growing for years, inequality has not decreased.
In spite of the economy having been growing for years, inequality has not decreased.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що було витрачено багато ресурсів, результат розчарував.
en: Despite many resources being spent, the result was disappointing.
In spite of many resources being spent, the result was disappointing.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри численні труднощі, є причини для оптимізму.
en: Despite numerous difficulties, there are reasons for optimism.
In spite of numerous difficulties, there are reasons for optimism.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на численні помилки, автор зробив вагомий внесок у науку.
en: Despite numerous mistakes, the author made a significant contribution to science.
In spite of numerous mistakes, the author made a significant contribution to science.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що доповідь мала бути короткою, вона тривала годину.
en: Despite the report being supposed to be short, it lasted an hour.
In spite of the report being supposed to be short, it lasted an hour.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Ми продовжимо підтримку, попри зміни в політичній ситуації.
en: We will continue support despite changes in the political situation.
We will continue support in spite of changes in the political situation.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що політика компанії була переглянута, основні проблеми не зникли.
en: Despite the company’s policy having been revised, the main issues have not disappeared.
Despite the fact that the company’s policy was revised, the main problems did not disappear.
Despite the company’s policy being revised, the main problems did not disappear.
In spite of the company’s policy having been revised, the main issues have not disappeared.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри позитивні зміни, система освіти все ще має недоліки.
en: Despite the positive changes, the education system still has flaws.
In spite of the positive changes, the education system still has flaws.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри відсутність достатньої інформації, рішення було прийнято.
en: Despite the lack of sufficient information, a decision was made.
In spite of the lack of sufficient information, a decision was made.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Попри досягнення, суспільство, ймовірно, зіткнеться з новими викликами.
en: Despite the achievements, society will likely face new challenges.
In spite of the achievements, society will likely face new challenges.

DESPITE_IN_SPITE_OF_ING.ua: Незважаючи на те, що багато людей закінчили навчання, багато випускників залишаються без роботи.
en: Despite having graduated, many graduates remain unemployed.
In spite of having graduated, many graduates remain unemployed.
